CHAPTER.VERS: And Bezaleel made the ark shittim wood: two cubits and a half the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold for it all around.
And he cast for it four rings of gold, by its four corners; even two rings upon its one side, and two rings upon its other side
And he made staffs shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
And he put the staffs into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
And he made the mercy seat pure gold: two cubits and a half the length of it, and one cubit and a half the breadth of it.

And he made two cherubim gold, beaten out of one piece he made them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
on…: or, out of, etc

One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubim on its two ends.
on the end: or, out of, etc
on the other end: or, out of, etc
And the cherubim spread out wings on high, covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; toward the mercy seat were the faces of the cherubim.
And he made the table shittim wood: two cubits its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height:
And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made for it a crown of gold all around.
Also he made for it a border of an handbreadth all around; and made a crown of gold for its border all around.
And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that in its four feet.
Close to the border were the rings, the places for the staffs to bear the table.
And he made the staffs shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

And he made the vessels which upon the table, its dishes, and its spoons, and its bowls, and its covers to cover with, pure gold.
to cover…: or, to pour out withal
And he made the lampstand pure gold: beaten work he made the lampstand; its shaft, and its branch, its bowls, its knobs, and its flowers, were of the same:
And six branches proceeding from its sides; three branches of the lampstand from the one side of it, and three branches of the lampstand from its other side:

Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knob and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knob and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the lampstand.
And in the lampstand four bowls made like almonds, its knobs, and its flowers:
And a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
Their knobs and their branches were of the same: all of it one beaten work pure gold.
And he made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuffdishes, pure gold.
a talent of pure gold he made it, and all its vessels.
And he made the incense altar shittim wood: the length of it a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; foursquare; and two cubits the height of it; the horns of it were of the same.
And he overlaid it with pure gold, the top of it, and its sides all around, and its horns: also he made for it a crown of gold all around.
And he made two rings of gold for it under its crown, by its two corners, upon its two sides, to be places for the staffs to bear it with.
And he made the staffs shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the perfumer.
